headline: Regulator Meets Scholar On Crypto
caption:
Pakistan's securities regulator met with Islamic scholar Mufti Taqi Usmani after his June 10 fatwa declared cryptocurrency not valid wealth, calling holdings fictitious account entries. The regulator, seeking approval for a planned stablecoin and tokenised assets, is pushing for a narrower, technology-specific review.

headline: US Subpoenas Times Reporters
caption:
US Justice Department subpoenaed New York Times reporters to appear before a Manhattan grand jury Wednesday and name sources for a story on security gaps aboard Trump's Qatari-gifted Air Force One. Officials call the report a leak.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Star's Dimming Mystery Solved
caption:
Astronomers say a decade-old mystery behind Tabby's Star's unexplained dimming is resolved: the pattern matches a giant orbiting planet, not an artificial megastructure. Researchers in Baton Rouge confirmed the mechanism with new observational data.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Planet Survives Its Star's Death
caption:
A white dwarf star 80 light-years away in Cornell-led James Webb observations still hosts a planet, WD 1856 b, orbiting closer than the star's original radius should allow. Astronomers say the excess heat indicates the planet migrated inward after its sun died.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Recitation Rewires Reading Brain
caption:
A four-day London trial found reciting poetry aloud, not silently reading or transcribing it, strengthened brain connections tied to motor planning and sensory processing, researchers say. The gains carried over to verses participants had never practiced.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Venezuela Toll Tops 4,300
caption:
4,333 people are confirmed dead in Venezuela after twin 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude earthquakes flattened La Guaira on June 24. Caracas is seeking release of 30 tons of gold frozen in Britain as the UN appeals for $296 million in response funds.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Strikes Reopen Hormuz War
caption:
US Central Command struck 140 targets in Iran after Iranian forces hit a Cyprus-flagged ship near the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has declared closed. Missile alerts sounded in Bahrain, Qatar and the UAE as Iran threatens further strikes on regional bases.

headline: Graham Dies Amid Iran War
caption:
Senator Lindsey Graham died Saturday at 71 during the third round of US strikes on Iran, having pushed harder for military action than any other Senate voice. Trump has not named a successor to lead Iran policy in the Senate GOP.

headline: Third Strikes Hit Bushehr
caption:
US forces struck 5 cities across Iran's Bushehr province, and Iran retaliated with missile strikes on Bahrain and four other Gulf states hosting American bases. Qatar said 3 people were hurt by missile debris as both sides accused each other of violating the Hormuz transit agreement.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Qatar Condemns Iran Strikes
caption:
Qatar condemned Iran's strikes on Jordan and 4 Gulf states after U.S. forces hit over 300 Iranian targets this week. Iranian parliament speaker Ghalibaf declared the Hormuz safe-passage pledge over, leaving future transits at risk of attack.

headline: Zelenskyy Taps Energy Chief
caption:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is replacing his prime minister, naming Naftogaz CEO German Koretskyi to lead the new cabinet as Ukraine braces for winter strikes on its energy grid. Parliament must approve the reshuffle within weeks.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Sky Offers Free Galaxy Bundle
caption:
Sky is offering a free 818-pound accessory bundle with new 36-month Galaxy S26 Ultra contracts signed by July 21, requiring only 100MB of base data. EE has a separate 720-pound discount on UK plans.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: McConnell Confirms Fall, Pneumonia
caption:
Senator Mitch McConnell was briefly unconscious after a fall and has since developed pneumonia in hospital. His office has given no return date, leaving his Senate seat effectively empty through recent war-powers votes.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: EU Recommends Under-13 Ban
caption:
European Union regulators propose banning children under 13 from social media and mandating zero screen time before age 3, EU Commission President von der Leyen said. Nearly 60% of European children report psychological harm from four to six hours of daily online use.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: SK Hynix Shares Crash
caption:
SK Hynix shares fell 15% in Seoul trading as investors question whether AI memory chip demand justifies the valuation. The company holds 58% of the AI memory chip market, according to Counterpoint Research.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Houthis Strike Saudi Arabia
caption:
Houthi forces fired missiles at Saudi Arabia after Yemen's government struck Sanaa airport, blocking a Houthi delegation's flight to Iran and ending a 2022 truce. Saudi air defenses intercepted the missiles, the coalition said.

headline: Europe's First Eclipse In 30 Years
caption:
A total solar eclipse will cross northern Spain at sunset on August 12, Europe's first in 30 years. The Moon, 400 times closer and 400 times smaller than the Sun, briefly matches its size to fully block it.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Demands Hormuz Fee
caption:
Washington reinstated a naval blockade of Iran and is demanding a 20 percent fee on all cargo transiting the Strait of Hormuz, as Iran's Revolutionary Guard claims strikes on regional vessels, bases and radar. The UN shipping agency says no legal basis exists for the toll.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: India Protests Hormuz Killing
caption:
India summoned Iran's deputy envoy after missiles struck two UAE-flagged tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, killing crew members including Indian nationals. Thirty of the 46 crew aboard the GFS Galaxy were Indian, with one sailor still missing since Sunday's attack.

headline: Spain Convicts PM's Brother
caption:
A Spanish court in Badajoz convicted Pedro Sánchez's brother of corruption, ruling a conservatory teaching post was created for him, and stripped his voting rights for 9 years. He can appeal; the case is one of several graft probes tied to the prime minister's circle.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: France Licenses Ukraine Missiles
caption:
France agreed to let Ukraine build Aster 30 interceptors and glide bombs on its own soil, moving Kyiv from donated weapons to domestic arms production. The deal lets Ukraine keep manufacturing the interceptors regardless of any future ceasefire terms.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: India-UK Trade Pact Begins
caption:
India's textile exports to Britain become duty-free from Wednesday under a new trade pact eliminating tariffs on 99% of goods traded both ways. The deal aims to nearly double bilateral trade to $100 billion by 2030 and gives Indian firms a 5-year exemption from UK payroll levies.

headline: US Strikes Kill Dozens in Iran
caption:
US strikes overnight killed dozens in Iran and wounded more than 260, the highest injury toll of the war, as Washington deployed over 20 warships in a naval blockade of Iranian ports. Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it will halt all Middle East energy exports through Hormuz unless the blockade lifts.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: EU Bars Draft-Age Ukrainian Men
caption:
The European Union will end protection status eligibility for Ukrainian draft-age men who leave the country starting March 2027, at Kyiv's request. The 4.4 million Ukrainians already sheltered in the EU keep their existing status.
